fields.title: The ordered 026b-to-022d fold is a sensitivity, not an exact-frame solution.
fields.finding: Apply the ordered .848 only to the global mode of the held 022d screened lead, with all other modes and masses held. The frequency-4 section/topology differs, so the resulting 1.067 multiplier is QUESTIONABLE. The exact source ratio is also shown; no reoptimization, material qualification or verified nonlinear first loss follows.
